newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to 0.05 lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to 0.05 lower.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent weaker, with players expected to focus on liquidating May contracts, dealers said.

Tuesday, May finished down 0.11 cent at 11.13 cents a lb, traded from 11.21 to 11.10, where dealers have pegged support. Most-active July fell 0.11 ent to 11.02, while the remaining months eased between 0.08 and 0.03 cent.
Support below 11.10 was pegged at 10.80 to 10.90. To the upside, resistance was pegged at ast week's high of 11.38 basis the May contract.
LIFFE white sugar futures were lower on Wednesday as players focused on the nearby August/October spread. At 0840 EDT/1340 GMT, the August contract stood down $1.70 to $306.90.
China said it would allow up to 500,000 tonnes of sugar tolling licences, and at least one cargo of sugar was loading early Wednesday, sugar traders in Hong Kong said.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
